_comment: Defaults. A project can override any key with __dwo-lens/config.json (same shape, merged key by key).

naming._comment: Asset class name -> allowed prefixes (UE5 style guide, allar/ue5-style-guide). Classes not listed are not checked.

unused._comment: Packages reachable from these roots are considered used. Maps and assets referenced from Config/*.ini are always roots.

smoke._comment: Map boot smoke test. maps empty = every .umap under Content minus exclude (globs on /Game paths), capped by maxMaps. fail: Fatal, crash, ensure, abnormal exit or errors > maxErrors. warn: any error, warnings > maxWarnings, or the game quit on its own before 'seconds'.

perf._comment: CSV profiler capture. map empty = command argument or GameDefaultMap. warmupFrames are captured but excluded from stats. fail: FrameTime p95 > budgetMs. warn: p99 > budgetMs or any frame > hitchMs.

sizes._comment: Content size scan. warn when one asset (with its .uexp/.ubulk and World Partition external actors) exceeds warnAssetMB.

trace._comment: Unreal Insights capture. map: command argument, then perf.map, then GameDefaultMap.

stateMonitor._comment: Optional adapter. Active only when the project itself contains the StateMonitor plugin.
